prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the report; the Bloomberg article could not be fetched. Bloomberg covers DeepSeek's release of V4.1-Flash-1017, which the company describes as offering 'stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion, and shorter outputs' than its predecessor.
DeepSeek frames the update as faster and leaner. The technical details of the release are covered in the wiki's entry on the announcement itself.
highlights: DeepSeek claims stronger benchmarks, faster task completion, shorter outputs
Basis: Techmeme summary; Bloomberg original not retrievable
